0.content: Navia met Clorinde as a girl of a little over ten through Clorinde's mentor, the Marechaussee Hunter Petronilla, a friend of Callas. They played tabletop games together, Clorinde hosting and Navia's wild choices keeping her on her toes. When Callas was framed, he chose a duel against Clorinde, asked her to look after his daughter, and refused to yield. For three years Navia could not forgive her, though they never fully broke off; Clorinde shadowed her to keep her promise. Once the truth came out in 4.0, they reconciled.

1.content: Callas Caspar, tall and blond with an anchor-marked eyepatch, founded the Spina di Rosula and sponsored Fontaine's aquabus system; the Callas Line bears his name. He refused the honorary title Palais Mermonia offered. He raised Navia as his successor in business, negotiation and weapons, but never spoke of his feelings or of her mother's death. Three years before the Fontaine Archon Quest, the Sinthe ring framed him for killing his informant Jacques; he died in a duel with Clorinde. Navia later learned he chose death so the ring would not touch her, since his associates would have released their evidence if she were harmed.

2.content: Melus, the steady, older attendant, and Silver, a nervous rookie, became Navia's bodyguards after Callas's death and followed her everywhere. When Primordial Seawater surged into lower Poisson in 4.2, both were dissolved while rescuing people. They had asked to be buried beside Callas, a wish she could not grant.

3.content: A citizen-oriented Fontainian society funded by supporters and business ventures. It works mainly with the people of Poisson and Fleuve Cendre, solves problems the Gardes won't or can't, and cooperates with the authorities when needed. Navia sums it up as a business partner that helps with any problem, "using the velvet glove or the iron fist as appropriate". Its heart-shaped rose logo was designed by Clementine. Members call Navia "Boss".

4.comment: Navia: The Sinthe case and Marcel
4.content: Sinthe was a popular Poisson drink secretly made from diluted Primordial Seawater, ruinous over time. Marcel, head of the Confrerie of Cabriere (supposedly a sister group to the Spina), ran the trade and was secretly Vacher, a Snezhnayan adventurer who had abducted young women for twenty years trying to revive his dissolved lover Vigneire. After Navia stirred up the disappearance case, he spiked her Fonta with Primordial Seawater; Paimon drank it instead, unharmed because she is not Fontainian. Navia and the Traveler traced the case to him, and she exposed him in court.

5.comment: Navia: The Poisson flood and the Fatui
5.content: In 4.2 a tremor released Primordial Seawater into lower Poisson; those it touched dissolved. The Spina treated the wounded and evacuated survivors. Arlecchino's House of the Hearth, exploring nearby ruins, joined the relief, counting heads and measuring water levels. Navia accepted gratefully but told the Traveler she would never leave herself vulnerable to the Fatui.
